solution_criteria: Meal plan must include at least 4 meals with high protein content (minimum 25g protein per meal)
Total daily calories should be in surplus (approximately 2800-3200 kcal for an 82kg athlete)
Include specific food items and portion sizes, not just meal categories
Distribute meals throughout the day to support muscle recovery and growth
Meal plan must exclude all meat and fish while maintaining adequate protein from plant-based sources
Include complex carbohydrates timed around potential training sessions for sustained energy
Provide specific vegetarian protein sources (legumes, tofu, nuts, dairy if applicable)
Ensure total calories support endurance training (approximately 2200-2600 kcal for a 58kg athlete)
Meal plan must be calorie-controlled (approximately 500-750 kcal deficit, around 1800-2000 kcal total)
All meals must be both gluten-free and dairy-free with clearly identified safe alternatives
Include adequate protein (minimum 120g daily) to preserve muscle mass during weight loss
Specify preparation methods and quantities to demonstrate how caloric deficit is achieved
